mapper.insert: INSERT INTO note (title, md_name, content, category, create_time) VALUES (#{title}, #{mdName}, #{content}, #{category}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: SELECT id, title, md_name, content, category, create_time, update_time, delete_time FROM note WHERE id = #{id} AND delete_time IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE note SET title = #{title}, md_name = #{mdName}, content = #{content}, category = #{category}, update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE id = #{id} AND delete_time IS NULL
